entries.title: Psalms 77:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph.>> I cried out to God with my voice-To God with my voice; And He gave ear to me.

entries.title: Psalms 77:2
segments: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord; My hand was stretched out in the night without ceasing; My soul refused to be comforted.

entries.title: Psalms 77:3
segments: I remembered God, and was troubled; I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 77:4
segments: You hold my eyelids [open]; I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

entries.title: Psalms 77:5
segments: I have considered the days of old, The years of ancient times.

entries.title: Psalms 77:6
segments: I call to remembrance my song in the night; I meditate within my heart, And my spirit makes diligent search.

entries.title: Psalms 77:7
segments: Will the Lord cast off forever? And will He be favorable no more?

entries.title: Psalms 77:8
segments: Has His mercy ceased forever? Has [His] promise failed forevermore?

entries.title: Psalms 77:9
segments: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has He in anger shut up His tender mercies? Selah

entries.title: Psalms 77:10
segments: And I said, "This [is] my anguish; [But I will remember] the years of the right hand of the Most High."

entries.title: Psalms 77:11
segments: ¶I will remember the works of the LORD; Surely I will remember Your wonders of old.

entries.title: Psalms 77:12
segments: I will also meditate on all Your work, And talk of Your deeds.

entries.title: Psalms 77:13
segments: Your way, O God, [is] in the sanctuary; Who [is] so great a God as [our] God?

entries.title: Psalms 77:14
segments: You [are] the God who does wonders; You have declared Your strength among the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 77:15
segments: You have with [Your] arm redeemed Your people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 77:16
segments: The waters saw You, O God; The waters saw You, they were afraid; The depths also trembled.

entries.title: Psalms 77:17
segments: The clouds poured out water; The skies sent out a sound; Your arrows also flashed about.

entries.title: Psalms 77:18
segments: The voice of Your thunder [was] in the whirlwind; The lightnings lit up the world; The earth trembled and shook.

entries.title: Psalms 77:19
segments: Your way [was] in the sea, Your path in the great waters, And Your footsteps were not known.

entries.title: Psalms 77:20
segments: You led Your people like a flock By the hand of Moses and Aaron.
